findings.title: Web management interface served over unencrypted HTTP
findings.impact: All web interactions, login attempts, and configurations are sent in plaintext and vulnerable to local eavesdropping.
findings.recommendation: Configure HTTPS encryption for the web management portal.

findings.title: Web interface allows login without user-supplied credentials
findings.impact: The login page does not require the user to input credentials, allowing anyone on the network to click LOGIN and access the admin dashboard.
findings.recommendation: Require users to configure and enter a unique administrator password during initial setup.
